workbuddy-cloud-task.title: WorkBuddy cloud task
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_not_cre: Inspect the original execution evidence. An explicit retry is allowed only when the original execution policy permits it.
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_waiting: Delegation is recorded. The original run and current scheduling conditions decide when a formal Runner can claim this node.

workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_run_pau: Use the original run controls to resume. Delegation does not start or resume a run.
workbuddy-cloud-task.platform_paused_bou: Pausing the platform run does not confirm that the original WorkBuddy task stopped. Use the original run controls to resume.
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_remote_: The original cloud task remains fixed. Query it explicitly; an unknown provider status never authorizes another creation.
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_waiting: The platform recorded a wait for input. Check the saved observation and account access before proceeding.

workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_interru: Cloud effects may remain. Keep the original attempt and checkpoint; do not create another task.
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_authori: New provider calls are blocked. A connected account alone does not restore the original execution authority.
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_observa: Keep the original task and observation operation. A later read cannot replace the original acknowledgement.
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_runner_: The original attempt lost its lease. Recover the formal Runner's original checkpoint; no remote stop or new creation is implied.
workbuddy-cloud-task.runner_hint_stop_un: Platform cancellation does not prove that the cloud task stopped. Original effects remain for verification.
